answer.reason: The verses only list Shallum among the gatekeepers and their descendants, and several marked verses concern other men of the name, so they say no more than the summary already does.
doubts: 1CH 26:14 names Shelemiah, and EZR 2:42 and NEH 7:45 name the children of Shallum, a family; neither clearly concerns this man.
JER 35:4 concerns a different Shallum, father of Maaseiah the keeper of the door.
1CH 9:17-19 name him as chief of the porters and over the service of the gates, which the summary and the tags already convey.
